name: bank-saving
source:
Reserve As Work 5,3
Reserve As Chip Data 6,2
Save "all.abs"
Save "work.abk",5
Save "data.abk",6
Erase All
Load "all.abs"
Print Length(5),Length(6)
Erase Temp
Print Length(5),Length(6)

encoding.notes: Explicit original Save=0x1838 and Save-with-number=0x1844 offsets and existing Reserve/Erase/Load/Length encodings. Program and expected AmBk/AmBs bytes are specified independently of the production writer/encoder. Generic lengths include the eight-byte name; bit 31 marks permanent data.

evidence.notes: Single-bank Save emits AmBk with number, chip/fast indicator, name-inclusive length and permanent flag. Grouped bank Save includes work banks and traverses the newest-first bank list, so bank 6 precedes 5. These explicit byte expectations and reload results are source-derived, not captured AMOS execution. Editor program-save work filtering is a separate path.
